title: Yellowed Crispy German Pork Casseroles
description: A buttery and crispy German dish featuring red chilli powder, perfect for midnight cravings, made low-calorie-friendly with careful ingredient selection. This en-croute dish is sure to satisfy any late-night hunger.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the pork strips over medium-high heat until browned, then set aside.
In the same skillet, add the chopped onion and cook until softened, then add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pork, onion mixture, red chilli powder, salt, and black pepper, and stir until well combined.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a large rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Brush the edges of the pastry with the beaten egg and spoon the pork mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the pastry with the melted butter and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Place the casserole on a baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
